detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Read positive Apple WalkingSpeed records, convert values to meters per second, and group by provider-local day. A current local day is eligible only when it has at least five positive WalkingSpeed records. Compute the current day P90 from those records. Look back over the preceding fourteen calendar days and keep eligible prior days with their own daily WalkingSpeed P90; require at least seven prior eligible days. Compute the median of those prior daily P90 values. Emit the activity-pacing context when current_day_walking_speed_p90 <= 0.80 * prior_14day_eligible_day_daily_p90_median. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open walking_speed_drop_easy_pace copy. Reuse the same source-qualified personal walking-speed context only to open one easy-pace action.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: If WalkingSpeed value/unit/timestamp/source identity, local-day assignment, at least five current-day positive records, at least seven prior eligible days in the preceding fourteen calendar days, duplicate handling, or coverage/signal-quality context is missing, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not substitute step count, route/terrain equivalence, running speed, workout intensity, gait/fall/fatigue/recovery labels, or missing watch/phone data. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not substitute unrelated signals or infer health, diagnosis, score, service action, delivery, frequency, or deduplication.

supported_coaching_use: Open bounded close-short copy when a daily walking-speed P90 is at or below 80 percent of the prior eligible-day median. The action is to stop chasing extra distance, steps, or speed for the day and close the walking plan short.
evidence_boundary: Walking-speed drop context is a bounded source-qualified personal pacing observation only. It is not fatigue, recovery/readiness, gait disorder, fall risk, health outcome, disease risk, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, exercise clearance, formula score, runtime authority, service action, delivery, frequency, or deduplication.

provider_contracts.method: Use positive Apple WalkingSpeed records grouped by local day; keep days with at least five records; compute daily P90 to avoid incidental slow segments; compare current daily P90 with the median of prior eligible days in the preceding fourteen calendar days when at least seven prior eligible days exist; emit context when current daily P90 is at or below 80 percent of that personal baseline. Do not infer cause or use a population gait threshold.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Walking speed is a descriptive personal activity-pacing context only; it is not a gait disorder, fall-risk, fatigue, recovery, health, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, score, service-action, delivery-cadence, or runtime-authority measure.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Read positive Apple WalkingSpeed records, convert values to meters per second, and group by provider-local day. A current local day is eligible only when it has at least five positive WalkingSpeed records. Compute the current day P90 from those records. Look back over the preceding fourteen calendar days and keep eligible prior days with their own daily WalkingSpeed P90; require at least seven prior eligible days. Compute the median of those prior daily P90 values. Emit the activity-pacing context when current_day_walking_speed_p90 <= 0.80 * prior_14day_eligible_day_daily_p90_median. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open walking_speed_drop_easy_pace copy. Reuse the same source-qualified walking-speed drop context only to open close-short copy: stop chasing extra distance, steps, or speed for the day and close the walking plan short.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: If WalkingSpeed value/unit/timestamp/source identity, local-day assignment, at least five current-day positive records, at least seven prior eligible days in the preceding fourteen calendar days, duplicate handling, or coverage/signal-quality context is missing, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not substitute step count, route/terrain equivalence, running speed, workout intensity, gait/fall/fatigue/recovery labels, or missing watch/phone data. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not substitute unrelated signals or infer health, diagnosis, score, service action, delivery, frequency, or deduplication. Do not convert missing provider rows, too few current walking-speed records, too few prior eligible days, absent source identity, unresolved local-day assignment, unqualified walking-speed provenance, route/terrain differences, or coverage ambiguity into fatigue, recovery/readiness, gait diagnosis, fall risk, health status, prescription, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Build rolling windows of seven observed resolved sleep nights. Calculate sleep midpoint for each night and the median absolute circular midpoint deviation in minutes. Emit sleep_timing_regular_context_present=true when midpoint_mad_minutes <= 180. This context may support reflection copy only and must not label chronotype, social jetlag, circadian disorder, insomnia, or prescribe a sleep schedule. Reuse the same source-qualified seven observed-night sleep-timing context only to open one-anchor-not-perfect copy: choose one small timing anchor rather than trying to make the whole sleep schedule rigid or perfect. The new line uses the same qualified timing context only to open one small sleep-timing anchor action.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Assign each source-qualified moderate/vigorous aerobic activity event to a user-local date and user-local week after duplicate/overlap resolution. Count distinct local dates in the week with at least one qualified event. Trigger when the weekly distinct qualified day count is below the threshold of 3 days for an observed week. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open aerobic_low_day_next_anchor copy. For this line, reuse the same complete-week and explicit moderate/vigorous activity-day context only to open one optional supported-walking planning action; do not infer social availability, motivation, fitness, need, benefit, fatigue, recovery or safety.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: If event timestamps, user-local week boundary, source-qualified moderate/vigorous classification, duplicate resolution, or coverage context is missing, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not treat missing source rows or incomplete weekly coverage as zero aerobic activity. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not substitute unrelated signals or infer health, diagnosis, score, service action, delivery, frequency, or deduplication.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: For each provider, resolve duplicate/overlapping exercise sessions, convert start timestamps to user-local clock time, retain one representative start time per session day, and build seven-day calendar windows. Trigger when at least three observed session days are present and the circular p90-to-p10 local start-time spread is at most six hours. Reuse the same source-qualified provider exercise start-time pattern context only to open keep-flexible copy: keep the time band loose and avoid adding a late or extra workout solely to preserve the timing pattern. Reuse the same source-qualified exercise timing pattern only to open one no-extra-workout boundary; do not infer an optimal clock time.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing start timestamp, timezone/local clock context, source identity, local-day boundary, duplicate/session resolution, or fewer than three observed session days yields unknown/no trigger. Do not infer an optimal exercise time from this context. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows, incomplete coverage, absent exercise records, unresolved timezone/local-clock context, or daily aggregate-only data as target failure, exercise insufficiency, or a need to preserve timing.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Require operating-supplied confirmed pneumonia context and active pneumonia coaching window before applying the copied source trigger. For each source-qualified provider sleep-duration series, assign each valid sleep record to a local sleep night, resolve naps/overlaps/duplicates, and build a current valid night plus prior 14 valid-night baseline window. Require at least seven prior valid nights. Compute prior_valid_night_median_minutes and emit context_present=true when current_sleep_duration_minutes < 0.8 * prior_valid_night_median_minutes. Use the context only to open non-safety-critical prioritization/postponement copy: choose one necessary task and postpone nonessential high-burden tasks or activities.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: If confirmed pneumonia context or pneumonia_coaching_window_active is not supplied by the operating product, emit no trigger. Missing sleep source, source identity, current valid night, local sleep-night assignment, timezone, nap/overlap resolution, coverage state, prior valid-night median, or seven prior valid nights yields no trigger. Missing nights are unknown, not zero sleep, not adequate sleep, and not a negative behavior label.

Missing nights are unknown and must not be treated as zero sleep or adequate sleep.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate Apple asleep-stage intervals by sleep-night end local day, require at least seven prior valid sleep nights in the preceding fourteen valid nights, calculate the prior median duration, and emit when current sleep duration is below 80 percent of that median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Direct sleep-duration history only; no cognition, fatigue, recovery, readiness, sleep-quality, disease, prescription, service action, or runtime authority.

provider_contracts.method: Use Samsung provider sleep_duration by sleep end local day, require at least seven prior valid sleep nights in the preceding fourteen valid nights, calculate the prior median duration, and emit when current sleep duration is below 80 percent of that median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Direct sleep-duration history only; no cognition, fatigue, recovery, readiness, sleep-quality, disease, prescription, service action, or runtime authority.

preprocessing_steps.null_missing_policy: Missing, invalid, or unqualified sleep records yield unknown.

Requires=source_identity_and_revision,provider_sleep_duration_record,valid_sleep_stage_or_session,duplicate_resolution. Transform=Read provider-specific sleep-duration records with source identity, timestamps or sleep end day, units, and provider provenance. Output=short_sleep_cognitive_load_planning_context (boolean_context_presence). Missingness=Missing, invalid, or unqualified sleep records yield unknown.
preprocessing_steps.calculation_expression: Read provider-specific sleep-duration records with source identity, timestamps or sleep end day, units, and provider provenance.

preprocessing_steps.null_missing_policy: Ambiguous episode, duplicate overlap, or unresolved local-night assignment yields no context.
preprocessing_steps.developer_instruction: Step 2: assign_local_sleep_night Input=HKCategoryTypeIdentifierSleepAnalysis.@value,HKCategoryTypeIdentifierSleepAnalysis.@startDate,HKCategoryTypeIdentifierSleepAnalysis.@endDate,HKCategoryTypeIdentifierSleepAnalysis.@sourceName,HKCategoryTypeIdentifierSleepAnalysis.@sourceVersion,HKCategoryTypeIdentifierSleepAnalysis.@device. Requires=sleep_end_local_day,nap_and_overlap_resolution,local_sleep_night_assignment. detail_contracts.calculation_rule: For each source-qualified provider sleep-duration series, assign each valid sleep record to a local sleep night, resolve naps/overlaps/duplicates, and build a current valid night plus prior 14 valid-night baseline window. Require at least seven prior valid nights. Compute prior_valid_night_median_minutes and emit context_present=true when current_sleep_duration_minutes < 0.8 * prior_valid_night_median_minutes. Use the context only to open non-safety-critical prioritization/postponement copy: choose one necessary task and postpone nonessential high-burden tasks or activities.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing sleep source, source identity, current valid night, local sleep-night assignment, timezone, nap/overlap resolution, coverage state, prior valid-night median, or seven prior valid nights yields no trigger. Missing nights are unknown, not zero sleep, not adequate sleep, and not a negative behavior label.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Require operating-supplied confirmed_pneumonia_context and pneumonia_coaching_window_active. Then apply the copied high-activity burden trigger exactly: For each provider-specific active-energy signal, aggregate positive energy exposure by provider-local day. Do not compare Apple ActiveEnergyBurned and Samsung SOURCE_TYPE_ALL calorie values to each other. For current day D, require current active-energy exposure > 0, build a baseline from positive observed active-energy days in D-14 through D-1, and require at least 7 positive prior days. Emit active_energy_activity_context_present when energy[D] >= 1.5 * median(prior positive active-energy days). Use the context only to open no-extra-push copy; do not create a calorie target, energy-balance claim, fatigue/recovery judgment, delivery policy, frequency policy, or service action. Reuse the same source-qualified high active-energy context only to open next-day-light-start copy: keep the next first movement short/easy rather than stacking another hard activity because the previous day was high.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, unresolved local day, missing current energy, nonpositive current energy, fewer than 7 positive prior energy days, unresolved coverage, or unresolved duplicate handling yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero energy, not low activity, and not a reason to add activity. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows, unresolved local-day assignment, incomplete coverage, or duplicate/overlap ambiguity as fatigue, recovery/readiness, diagnosis, or need for prescription. If confirmed_pneumonia_context is false/missing or pneumonia_coaching_window_active is false/missing, emit no trigger. Missing activity source fields remain unknown; do not infer pneumonia, fatigue, recovery, severity, immune/inflammation state, overtraining, or activity clearance.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: For each source-qualified activity-load signal, aggregate or summarize load by user-local day according to the provider contract. Evaluate each current local day with a recent 7-local-day window and a prior 14-local-day baseline window. Require at least 3 recent positive load days and at least 7 prior positive load days. Compute recent_positive_day_mean = sum(recent positive-day load) / count(recent positive days). Compute prior_positive_day_median over the prior positive load days. Trigger when recent_positive_day_mean is at least 1.5 times prior_positive_day_median. Reuse the same source-qualified personal activity-load context only to open one one-step planning action.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, unresolved local-day boundary, fewer than 3 recent positive activity-load days, fewer than 7 prior positive activity-load days, unresolved overlap, incomplete coverage, or missing timezone yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Resolve one provider-qualified sleep session in the user local timezone. Classify it as a daytime nap only when it starts within the configured local daytime window and is not part of the resolved primary overnight sleep episode. Derive duration from start/end or provider duration and emit when duration exceeds 15 minutes. Use this context only to open one future short-nap action; do not infer sleep quality, sleep need, sleepiness, fatigue, recovery, disease or safety.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, timestamps/duration, local timezone, daytime classification, primary-sleep episode resolution, adult context or coverage yields no trigger. Missing data is unknown, not no nap or poor sleep.

source_field_contracts.transform_rule: Parse endDate with timezone and require endDate > startDate before using the interval. Build source-qualified resolved sleep nights. For daily range triggers compare hours with 7 and 9. For repeated-window triggers use seven observed resolved nights, derived duration and/or sleep midpoint as specified by the output contract.

output_contracts.emit_rule: Emit context_present=true when a source-qualified daytime sleep session exceeds 15 minutes and all local-time, provider and coverage prerequisites are present.

supported_coaching_use: Open one independent general daily-life sleep-anchor line after the source-qualified personal sleep-duration variability crossing. The action is to keep one wake-time anchor for three days, not to prescribe sleep duration or diagnose sleep state.
evidence_boundary: This is multi-night sleep-duration variability context only. It is not sleep quality, sleep need, insomnia, health outcome, disease risk, diagnosis, treatment, prescription, readiness, recovery, score, runtime authority, service action, delivery timing, frequency, or deduplication. The new line is a short-horizon sleep-anchor behavior opportunity only; it does not measure sleep quality, sleep need, fatigue, recovery, circadian state, health, disease, safety, treatment, or outcome.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate resolved asleep-stage minutes by local wake date; with at least seven nights, calculate (p90-p10)/personal median and observe a new crossing at 0.25 with a seven-day re-trigger gap.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Descriptive observed sleep-duration pattern only; no sleep-quality or sleep-need inference.

provider_contracts.method: Use resolved provider sleep_duration minutes by local wake date; with at least seven nights, calculate (p90-p10)/personal median and observe a new crossing at 0.25 with a seven-day re-trigger gap.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Require external dyslipidemia/adult context and reuse the replay-backed activity-volume baseline-gap family exactly: current_daily_value < 0.5 * prior 14-day positive median with at least seven prior positive days, or source-specific 2/4 day recorded-gap path. Emit only one activity-snack behavior opportunity.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing external context, source identity, coverage, baseline, quiet window, red-flag boundary, or clinician boundary emits no trigger; missing rows are unknown, not low activity.

numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: external dyslipidemia context plus source-qualified activity-volume baseline drop or recorded gap with prior 14 day baseline, seven valid prior positive days, current value below 0.5 of prior positive median, source-specific 2 or 4 day gap rules, and quiet window
numeric_parameters.signal_window: local day or source-specific recorded gap

provider_contracts.method: Read positive FlightsClimbed records, reconcile source identity, sum by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current count is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded cumulative FlightsClimbed only; no equivalence to stair ability, strength, balance, intensity, or target.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded cycling distance by local day; require seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded cycling distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded exercise minutes by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded exercise-time change only; Apple field estimation is not adopted as individual intensity.

provider_contracts.method: On complete local days, detect a prior positive recorded exercise-time day followed by two complete days without a positive recorded value; missing coverage yields unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The signal is provider-recorded exercise time, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Count distinct valid stood-hour categories per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current count is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded category-count change, not standing duration, sedentary time, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded standing time by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded standing-time change only and is not a sedentary-time estimate.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded distance by local day; require at least seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded walking/running distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, health, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current active_time is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded active-time change, not energy balance, all-activity change, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day, require seven valid positive prior days, and emit on the second of two consecutive observed days below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded active_time gap only; missing data is not no movement.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-distance sessions, reconcile source identity, sum recorded distance by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current distance is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded exercise distance only; no equivalence to total movement or target.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-duration sessions, reconcile source identity, sum duration by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current duration is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded session duration only; no intensity or target equivalence.

provider_contracts.method: Resolve positive Samsung exercise sessions by local day; require a prior positive session, four subsequent complete coverage days without a session, and a three-day quiet window after a prior emitted context. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: This output describes a Samsung-recorded session gap only, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung activity.day_summary longest_active_time to one representative value per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded longest-bout change, not total activity, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive provider pedometer-distance rows, reconcile source identity and local day, aggregate one daily value, require seven valid prior days, and emit when the current daily value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded pedometer distance only; no equivalence to exercise-session distance or complete movement coverage.

evidence_boundary: Official recovery guidance supports rest, not rushing recovery, and gradual return toward normal activities. This trigger only uses source-qualified activity-volume baseline-drop or recorded-gap context to support a small re-entry message for an externally confirmed pneumonia audience during an active coaching window. It does not infer pneumonia, recovery status, severity, hypoxemia, activity clearance, deterioration, fatigue, readiness, treatment, diagnosis, score, runtime authority, service action, or delivery timing. Source refs: NHS pneumonia page reviewed 2026-07-17; American Lung Association Pneumonia Treatment and Recovery updated 2025-08-14; NICE NG250 recovery information.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive FlightsClimbed records, reconcile source identity, sum by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current count is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded cumulative FlightsClimbed only; no equivalence to stair ability, strength, balance, intensity, or target.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded cycling distance by local day; require seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded cycling distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded exercise minutes by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded exercise-time change only; Apple field estimation is not adopted as individual intensity.

provider_contracts.method: On complete local days, detect a prior positive recorded exercise-time day followed by two complete days without a positive recorded value; missing coverage yields unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The signal is provider-recorded exercise time, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Count distinct valid stood-hour categories per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current count is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded category-count change, not standing duration, sedentary time, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded standing time by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded standing-time change only and is not a sedentary-time estimate.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded distance by local day; require at least seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded walking/running distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, health, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current active_time is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded active-time change, not energy balance, all-activity change, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day, require seven valid positive prior days, and emit on the second of two consecutive observed days below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded active_time gap only; missing data is not no movement.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-distance sessions, reconcile source identity, sum recorded distance by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current distance is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded exercise distance only; no equivalence to total movement or target.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-duration sessions, reconcile source identity, sum duration by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current duration is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded session duration only; no intensity or target equivalence.

provider_contracts.method: Resolve positive Samsung exercise sessions by local day; require a prior positive session, four subsequent complete coverage days without a session, and a three-day quiet window after a prior emitted context. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: This output describes a Samsung-recorded session gap only, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung activity.day_summary longest_active_time to one representative value per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded longest-bout change, not total activity, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive provider pedometer-distance rows, reconcile source identity and local day, aggregate one daily value, require seven valid prior days, and emit when the current daily value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded pedometer distance only; no equivalence to exercise-session distance or complete movement coverage.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Require operating-supplied confirmed pneumonia context and active pneumonia coaching window. Then reuse the replay-backed activity-volume baseline-gap family exactly: baseline-drop paths require current_daily_value < 0.5 * prior 14-day positive median with at least seven prior positive days; recorded-gap paths require the source-specific complete no-positive or below-half gap state. Emit only a small gradual re-entry context.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: If confirmed pneumonia context or pneumonia_coaching_window_active is not supplied by the operating product, emit no trigger. Missing source identity, incomplete coverage, insufficient baseline, unresolved duplicates, quiet-window failure, red flags, or clinician restriction yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: confirmed pneumonia context and active pneumonia coaching window plus any preserved source-specific activity-volume baseline-drop or recorded-gap trigger with prior 14 day baseline, seven valid prior positive days, current value below 0.5 of prior positive median, source-specific 2 or 4 day recorded-gap rules, and quiet window
numeric_parameters.guidance_basis: rest, do not rush recovery, gradual return to normal activities
numeric_parameters.required_context: confirmed_pneumonia_context; pneumonia_coaching_window_active; line-specific source-qualified sleep/activity context; coverage and missingness context; duplicate resolution; provider provenance

evidence_boundary: NHS and NHLBI guidance support rest, light activity and not forcing normal activity. provider_contracts.method: Read positive FlightsClimbed records, reconcile source identity, sum by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current count is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded cumulative FlightsClimbed only; no equivalence to stair ability, strength, balance, intensity, or target.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded cycling distance by local day; require seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded cycling distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded exercise minutes by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded exercise-time change only; Apple field estimation is not adopted as individual intensity.

provider_contracts.method: On complete local days, detect a prior positive recorded exercise-time day followed by two complete days without a positive recorded value; missing coverage yields unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The signal is provider-recorded exercise time, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Count distinct valid stood-hour categories per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current count is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded category-count change, not standing duration, sedentary time, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded standing time by local day; require seven valid prior days and emit when current time is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The output describes recorded standing-time change only and is not a sedentary-time estimate.

provider_contracts.method: Aggregate positive provider-recorded distance by local day; require at least seven valid prior days in the prior 14 days and emit when current distance is below 50 percent of the prior-day median. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: The calculation describes a change in recorded walking/running distance, not a change in all activity, fitness, health, or intensity.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current active_time is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded active-time change, not energy balance, all-activity change, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung active_time by local day, require seven valid positive prior days, and emit on the second of two consecutive observed days below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded active_time gap only; missing data is not no movement.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-distance sessions, reconcile source identity, sum recorded distance by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current distance is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded exercise distance only; no equivalence to total movement or target.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive-duration sessions, reconcile source identity, sum duration by local day, require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a complete current day, then emit when current duration is below half the prior median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded session duration only; no intensity or target equivalence.

provider_contracts.method: Resolve positive Samsung exercise sessions by local day; require a prior positive session, four subsequent complete coverage days without a session, and a three-day quiet window after a prior emitted context. Missing coverage is unknown.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: This output describes a Samsung-recorded session gap only, not all movement or guideline compliance.

provider_contracts.method: Reconcile Samsung activity.day_summary longest_active_time to one representative value per local day; require seven valid positive days in the prior 14 days and a positive complete current day, then emit when current value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: A bounded recorded longest-bout change, not total activity, intensity, fitness, or health.

provider_contracts.method: Read positive provider pedometer-distance rows, reconcile source identity and local day, aggregate one daily value, require seven valid prior days, and emit when the current daily value is below 50 percent of the prior positive-day median.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Provider-recorded pedometer distance only; no equivalence to exercise-session distance or complete movement coverage.

Emit only a task-splitting behavior opportunity.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing external context, source identity, coverage, baseline, quiet window, red-flag boundary, or clinician boundary emits no trigger; missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.

numeric_parameters.trigger_rule: external pneumonia recovery context plus source-qualified activity-volume baseline drop or recorded gap with prior 14 day baseline, seven valid prior positive days, current value below 0.5 of prior positive median, source-specific 2 or 4 day gap rules, and quiet window
numeric_parameters.signal_window: local day or source-specific recorded gap

Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'gr_fact_41_apple_activity_sleep_inactivity_hours_day, gr_fact_41_samsung_activity_sleep_inactivity_hours_day'. It derives estimated_sedentary_like_inactivity_hours_per_day from Apple or Samsung activity/sleep/coverage context after waking low/no-movement segmentation and sleep, nonwear, workout/exercise, unobserved interval, duplicate, and local-day handling. It does not claim measured sitting posture, recreational screen purpose, daily total steps as sedentary time, nonwear/sleep as sedentary time, disease/risk status, guideline compliance, prescription, service action, or runtime delivery authority.. detail_contracts.calculation_rule: For each provider-local day, build source-qualified timestamped positive step/activity events. Use a 06:00-23:00 local waking observation window. Derive low/no-movement intervals as gaps between positive activity events inside that window, subtract overlapping sleep and workout/exercise intervals when source intervals are present, sum remaining gap minutes by local day, and convert to estimated_sedentary_like_inactivity_hours_per_day. Emit the fact41 above-target planning trigger when that value is > 8 hours/day. For replay calibration, evaluated days require the complete-day heuristic first_positive_activity_time <= 10:00 and last_positive_activity_time >= 20:00; operating implementations may replace this heuristic with a stronger provider wear/phone presence contract, but must not count unobserved time as sedentary-like inactivity without such coverage. Reuse the same source-qualified fact41 sedentary-like inactivity context only to open no-catchup-burst copy: avoid one large compensatory workout burst and start with one short break/restart. Reuse the same source-qualified fact41 sedentary-like inactivity context only to open early-first-break anchor copy: place the next first short break earlier in the day rather than waiting for another long quiet block. Reuse the same source-qualified fact41 context only to open one transition-break action.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing timestamped activity intervals, aggregate-only daily step totals, unresolved provider source identity, unresolved local-day timezone, absent observation/coverage context, or inability to distinguish sleep/workout/exercise/unobserved intervals yields unknown/no trigger. Missing device rows, nonwear, sleep, workout, exercise, travel, long charging/off-body periods, or other unobserved time must not be converted into sedentary-like inactivity unless a provider-specific presence contract qualifies the observation window. This trigger is a planning proxy only and not a negative behavior label. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows as confirmed inactivity, measured sitting, sedentary time, activity target, or exercise prescription. provider_contracts.method: For each observed Apple provider local week, count distinct local days with an aerobic Workout of at least 10 minutes that has at least 10 continuous same-source PhysicalEffort minutes at MET >=3.0 for the moderate branch and MET >=6.0 for the vigorous branch. Emit the context only when moderate qualified days <5 and vigorous qualified days <3.
provider_contracts.evidence_boundary: Apple Workout plus same-source PhysicalEffort MET intervals can support a source-qualified weekly moderate/vigorous aerobic session-day alternative context for users whose dyslipidemia status is supplied by operating/profile input. detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Evaluate trigger_rule= 'emit_when_late_activity_end_and_sleep_window_are_qualified'. Derive trigger_measure_key= 'late_activity_sleep_winddown_buffer_context' with unit= 'boolean_context_presence'. Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'evening_sleep_winddown_apple_activity_sleep, evening_sleep_winddown_samsung_activity_sleep'. Provider contracts= 2, preprocessing steps= 12, replay/calibration rows= 1. Required contexts are: late_activity_or_exercise_session_end_time, activity_intensity_or_strain_proxy, habitual_sleep_onset_baseline, exercise_end_to_habitual_sleep_onset_interval, same_night_sleep_onset_or_sleep_window, sleep_duration_context, device_presence_or_wear_confidence, missingness_policy, winddown_buffer_copy_only. Supported use: Open a new general line that uses source-qualified late activity plus sleep timing context to suggest a bounded wind-down buffer before sleep.. Boundary: This is a practical sleep/activity composition context only. It is not an evening-exercise ban, sleep or exercise timing prescription, insomnia/circadian disorder inference, performance optimization, cardiometabolic risk prediction, readiness/recovery/sleep-quality score, formula score, service action, diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice.. Reuse the same source-qualified late-activity/sleep-window context only to open one warm-wash action.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Use the prior 14-night sleep baseline when at least 7 valid nights exist. Trigger when prior-night sleep duration is below 420 minutes or below 85 percent of the prior median, or sleep onset shifts at least 60 minutes from circular baseline, and the next day has a source-qualified activity-window proxy. Reuse the same source-qualified sleep-deviation next-day window context only to open no-full-reset copy: do not turn the whole day into a catch-up or reset plan. Reuse the same source-qualified sleep-deviation and next-day activity-window context only to open one easy first-movement action.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing sleep duration/onset, fewer than 7 prior valid nights, missing next-day activity-window evidence, or unresolved device/wear confidence yields no trigger. Do not convert missing sleep data, incomplete prior-night baseline, missing next-day activity window, absent source identity, unresolved local-day assignment, unresolved shift-work/clinical sleep-disorder filter, or missing device confidence into sleep disorder, fatigue, recovery/readiness, prescription, diagnosis, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: For each provider separately, reconcile positive activity-duration records, assign them to user-local days, and sum non-overlapping minutes. Compute current_seven_day_activity_minutes across the current day plus six previous local days. Compute three immediately prior non-overlapping positive seven-day totals and their median. Trigger only when current_seven_day_activity_minutes < 0.5 * prior_three_positive_week_median_minutes and the crossing is new after the quiet window. Reuse the same weekly low activity-volume context only to open no-catch-up-burst copy: avoid making up the low week all at once and resume with a lower-burden movement step. Reuse the same personal weekly activity-volume drop context only to open one no-catch-up boundary action.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing source identity/provenance, timestamp, duration value/unit, local-day assignment, duplicate/overlap resolution, current seven-day window, three prior positive seven-day windows, baseline median, or quiet-window state yields no trigger. Missing calendar days are unknown and must not be treated as zero activity. Missing or incomplete weekly context yields no trigger; do not zero-fill missing days or convert a low week into an amount/intensity prescription.

source_field_contracts.transform_rule: Parse as provider timestamp with timezone; require endDate >= startDate when present. After source parsing, reconcile overlaps, sum positive minutes by user-local day, compute the current rolling seven-day total, then compare it with 0.5 times the median of three immediately prior positive seven-day totals. This same source-qualified weekly low activity-volume context opens the 1996 next-week-known-slot line.
source_field_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing or unparseable endDate blocks interval reconciliation unless provider row duration semantics are otherwise unambiguous. Missing calendar days are unknown and must not be zero-filled. detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Apple v1: pair daily median WalkingSpeed and WalkingHeartRateAverage by local day; require at least 7 prior paired walking days in the prior 30 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of the prior speed median, and current walking HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Samsung v1: use walking/running exercise sessions with mean_speed and mean_heart_rate; require at least 7 prior same-type sessions in the prior 60 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of prior speed median, and current mean HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Emit only bounded body-feel prompt context when quality, coverage, duplicate, acute-context, and no-recent-answer gates pass. Reuse the same source-qualified same-pace higher-HR context only to open keep-easy pacing copy: lower the next movement anchor instead of continuing to push the same pace.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing paired speed/heart-rate context, fewer than 7 prior comparable observations, speed outside +/-5 percent similarity band, heart-rate ratio below 1.10, unresolved quality/coverage, unresolved presence/duplicate/acute-context filters, or recent equivalent answer yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not normal fitness and not disease. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows, incomplete coverage, absent paired observations, failed quality gates, or daily aggregate-only data as normal fitness, target failure, disease, recovery/readiness, or a need to change exercise intensity.

Samsung v1: use walking/running exercise sessions with mean_speed and mean_heart_rate; require at least 7 prior same-type sessions in the prior 60 days, current speed within +/-5 percent of prior speed median, and current mean HR >= 1.10 * prior HR median. Emit only bounded lower-next-pace context when quality, coverage, duplicate and acute-context gates pass. Reuse the same source-qualified same-pace higher-HR context only to open lower-next-pace copy: lower the next movement anchor instead of continuing to push the same pace.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Within each ISO week, calculate the median sleep midpoint for weekday nights and weekend nights when both day types are observed. Mark weekend sleep shift when the weekend median midpoint is at least 90 minutes and at most 720 minutes later than the weekday median. detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Evaluate trigger_rule= 'emit_when_inactivity_gap_and_move_prompt_window_are_qualified'. Derive trigger_measure_key= 'inactivity_gap_move_prompt_context' with unit= 'boolean_context_presence'. Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'inactivity_gap_move_prompt_apple_step, inactivity_gap_move_prompt_samsung_step'. Required contexts are: timestamped_step_or_activity_intervals, prolonged_no_movement_or_low_step_interval, wear_or_phone_presence_confidence, nonwear_or_phone_absence_filter, intentional_rest_travel_or_meeting_context_filter, posture_uncertainty_boundary, move_prompt_opportunity_window, red_flag_or_clinician_boundary, missingness_policy, move_prompt_copy_only. Supported use: Close the existing general inactivity-gap move prompt from source-qualified no/low-movement interval context without requiring a subsequent movement event.. Boundary: This is bounded daily-health prompt context only. It is not measured sitting, sedentary-time measurement, glucose or insulin improvement, vascular diagnosis, disease-risk prediction, exact break-dose prescription, readiness/recovery/formula score, service action, diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice.. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open easy-restart copy: lower the first movement burden to a very short stand, stretch, or walk. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open transition-anchor copy: attach one tiny movement to the next natural transition point instead of creating a separate workout plan. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open one comfortable stretch-break action.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Evaluate trigger_rule= 'emit_when_inactivity_gap_and_move_prompt_window_are_qualified'. Derive trigger_measure_key= 'inactivity_gap_move_prompt_context' with unit= 'boolean_context_presence'. Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'inactivity_gap_move_prompt_apple_step, inactivity_gap_move_prompt_samsung_step'. Provider contracts= 2, preprocessing steps= 12, replay/calibration rows= 1. Required contexts are: timestamped_step_or_activity_intervals, prolonged_no_movement_or_low_step_interval, wear_or_phone_presence_confidence, nonwear_or_phone_absence_filter, intentional_rest_travel_or_meeting_context_filter, posture_uncertainty_boundary, move_prompt_opportunity_window, red_flag_or_clinician_boundary, missingness_policy, move_prompt_copy_only. Supported use: Close the existing general inactivity-gap move prompt from source-qualified no/low-movement interval context without requiring a subsequent movement event.. Boundary: This is bounded daily-health prompt context only. It is not measured sitting, sedentary-time measurement, glucose or insulin improvement, vascular diagnosis, disease-risk prediction, exact break-dose prescription, readiness/recovery/formula score, service action, diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice.. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open easy-restart copy: lower the first movement burden to a very short stand, stretch, or walk. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open transition-anchor copy: attach one tiny movement to the next natural transition point instead of creating a separate workout plan. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open one short walk-in-place action.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: If any required context, provider contract input, preprocessing step, timezone/window assignment, coverage check, or duplicate-resolution prerequisite is unavailable, emit unknown/no trigger. Do not convert missing device data, missing user/profile input, or missing source coverage into a negative behavior label. Do not bypass the evidence boundary or create runtime delivery authority. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows as confirmed inactivity, measured sitting, sedentary time, activity target, or exercise prescription. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows, unresolved presence/nonwear context, intentional rest/travel/meeting context, or red-flag boundary failure as confirmed inactivity, measured sitting, sedentary time, activity target, or exercise prescription.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Within each local day, inspect source-qualified positive step/activity events between 10:00 and 18:00 local. Emit inactivity_gap_move_prompt_context when at least one no-positive-event gap is >= 120 minutes and wear/phone presence plus nonwear/context filters are qualified. This is a no/low-movement prompt context only, not measured sitting or sedentary time. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open easy-restart copy: lower the first movement burden to a very short stand, stretch, or walk.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing timestamped intervals, aggregate-only daily totals, unresolved local day/source identity, missing wear or phone presence, nonwear/intentional-rest/travel/meeting ambiguity, red-flag or clinician boundary, or unresolved posture uncertainty yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown and must not be treated as inactivity. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not treat missing provider rows as confirmed inactivity, measured sitting, sedentary time, activity target, or exercise prescription.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Evaluate trigger_rule= 'emit_when_inactivity_gap_and_move_prompt_window_are_qualified'. Derive trigger_measure_key= 'inactivity_gap_move_prompt_context' with unit= 'boolean_context_presence'. Use source-qualified derivation contracts= 'inactivity_gap_move_prompt_apple_step, inactivity_gap_move_prompt_samsung_step'. Provider contracts= 2, preprocessing steps= 12, replay/calibration rows= 1. Required contexts are: timestamped_step_or_activity_intervals, prolonged_no_movement_or_low_step_interval, wear_or_phone_presence_confidence, nonwear_or_phone_absence_filter, intentional_rest_travel_or_meeting_context_filter, posture_uncertainty_boundary, move_prompt_opportunity_window, red_flag_or_clinician_boundary, missingness_policy, move_prompt_copy_only. Supported use: Close the existing general inactivity-gap move prompt from source-qualified no/low-movement interval context without requiring a subsequent movement event.. Boundary: This is bounded daily-health prompt context only. It is not measured sitting, sedentary-time measurement, glucose or insulin improvement, vascular diagnosis, disease-risk prediction, exact break-dose prescription, readiness/recovery/formula score, service action, diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice.. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open easy-restart copy: lower the first movement burden to a very short stand, stretch, or walk. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open transition-anchor copy: attach one tiny movement to the next natural transition point instead of creating a separate workout plan. Reuse the same source-qualified inactivity-gap context only to open one optional light household-chore action; chore availability remains unknown and is not inferred. Require external diabetes and adult context before opening one optional light household-chore action; do not infer diabetes or glycemic state.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Aggregate provider HRV observations to a provider-local daily median. Aggregate sleep observations to the sleep end local date. For date D, require sleep_hours[D] < 6.0, current HRV[D] > 0, at least 7 positive HRV days in D-14 through D-1, and HRV[D] <= 0.8 * median(prior 14-day HRV values). Emit hrv_short_sleep_body_feel_context_present only when source identity, HRV timing/quality, sleep coverage, confounder filter, and no_recent_equivalent_feeling_answer are present. A recent equivalent feeling answer suppresses the prompt; it is not required to activate it. Reuse the same source-qualified derived context only to open short_sleep_cardio_no_extra_push copy.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing HRV timing/quality, missing sleep duration, sleep >= 6 hours, fewer than 7 prior HRV days, current HRV above the low-ratio threshold, unresolved sleep/wear coverage, unresolved confounder filter, or recent equivalent feeling answer yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not normal recovery and not poor recovery. Missing or incomplete context yields no trigger; do not substitute unrelated signals or infer health, diagnosis, score, service action, delivery, frequency, or deduplication.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Aggregate provider HRV observations to a provider-local daily median. Aggregate sleep observations to the sleep end local date. For date D, require sleep_hours[D] < 6.0, current HRV[D] > 0, at least 7 positive HRV days in D-14 through D-1, and HRV[D] <= 0.8 * median(prior 14-day HRV values). Emit hrv_short_sleep_body_feel_context_present only when source identity, HRV timing/quality, sleep coverage, confounder filter, and no_recent_equivalent_feeling_answer are present. A recent equivalent feeling answer suppresses the prompt; it is not required to activate it. Reuse the same source-qualified short-sleep plus low-HRV context only to open no-number-chase copy: avoid chasing or interpreting the HRV value or ratio.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: Missing source identity, missing HRV timing/quality, missing sleep duration, sleep >= 6 hours, fewer than 7 prior HRV days, current HRV above the low-ratio threshold, unresolved sleep/wear coverage, unresolved confounder filter, or recent equivalent feeling answer yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not normal recovery and not poor recovery. Do not convert missing provider data, incomplete coverage, absent source identity, unresolved local-day assignment, absent HRV baseline, unresolved acute-context filter, or recent-answer suppression into HRV meaning, vagal tone, autonomic state, stress, sleep quality, fatigue, recovery/readiness, illness, exercise clearance, diagnosis, score, delivery, frequency, dedup, or service-action logic.

supported_coaching_use: Open a BP/HTN-scoped weekly aerobic-frequency coaching line when provider exercise records show fewer than five source-qualified aerobic exercise days in an observed local week. Use only as a small weekly anchor prompt, not as medical advice, BP control inference, or activity clearance.
evidence_boundary: Fact 129 is about aerobic exercise frequency for hypertension. This trigger counts source-qualified Apple/Samsung aerobic exercise days when BP/HTN context is externally confirmed. It is not a diagnosis, BP-control claim, prescription, guideline score, or proof the user did not exercise off-device.

provider_contracts.method: For each user-local week with observed Apple Workout source presence, count distinct local days having an aerobic Workout of at least 10 minutes from a source identity. Emit the context when the count is below five distinct days.

detail_contracts.calculation_rule: Require operating-supplied elevated-BP/hypertension context. Then compute the high-after-quiet rule: at least 7 positive prior days in the prior 14-day baseline, prior positive-day median, both immediately prior local days below that median, and current local-day activity signal greater than 150 percent of that median. Emit only the BP/HTN next-activity-lighten context.
detail_contracts.missingness_policy: If BP/HTN context or route boundary is not supplied by the operating product, emit no trigger. Missing source identity, insufficient prior positive days, missing prior two days, unresolved duplicate/overlap, low capture confidence, or red-flag/clinician restriction yields no trigger. Missing rows are unknown, not zero activity.
